display_long_description:
# Required Practicals VR is an app made by a post-GCSE student to revolutionise revision for AQA GCSE Science. 

Required practicals make up over **15% of all marks** over the exams, which is about **2 entire grades** for each component of a students' Triple Science grade or overall Combined Science grade. Obviously, that's a pretty big deal.

Knowing this, its truly important that you revise it as best as you can. Should you be fortunate enough to have access to the resources to set up required practicals, you can consider a large portion of your revision done. However, if you are in conditions such that you don't have access to set these up - **you are effectively stuck**.

Let me introduce Required Practicals VR, an app that enables you to do any of the 28* required practicals of the AQA GCSE Science specification whenever you wish to. The app features several features to guide you in your learning: a demonstration of what you'll need to do in the practical (providing a **visual form** of learning) and a voice over explaining what is actually happening (providing a **auditory form** of learning). Then you can choose to watch it again or recreate the practical from memory (providing a **kinaesthetic form** of learning) - and should you get stuck, there will always be a clipboard with written instructions (providing a **reading form** of learning). This will maximise your learning and truly ensure you boost your grade!
